name: COMP_010
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (78%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs InSitu · Careful review
InSitu is in the 90% conformal set; invasive risk is 2% [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 78%, InSitu 20%, Invasive 2% | Benign leads |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu | Cannot separate the two |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.96; OOD pct 1.0 | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Models concur |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 Benign [F5] | Neighbors lean InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (regions 5, 6, 7) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; points away from invasion · Weak
- **Scarce benign stroma or fat** (region 9) · ↑ invasive · Low score; mild push toward invasive · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 9, 10) · ↓ invasive · High score; lower invasive likelihood · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 2, 3, 4) · ↑ invasive · Scored high; spot check 3/20 · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions cuts invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so not shown to reflect the classifier. Unreliable here: necrosis.

## Could be wrong if
- Three of five neighbors are InSitu; disease may be in situ.
- Margin model calls tumor at superior and lateral edges, unlike the 2% invasive score [F7].

## Check on the slide
1. **5, 6, 7** — Confirm atypical cells stay inside ducts.
2. **2, 3, 4** — Verify necrosis; its AI spot check failed.
3. **1, 2, 3** — Compare superior margin call with the low invasive score.
